instructions: Complete each sentence in a set with the correct ending from the list given with that set. Write the correct letter on your answer sheet.

groups.instructions:
Questions 1-5 refer to Passage G07 - What Houseplants Really Do to the Air Indoors

Complete each sentence with the correct ending, A-H.
Write the correct letter, A-H, in boxes 1-5 on your answer sheet.

options.text: the wettest reading of all was still twenty points short of the seventy per cent at which mould sets in
a room of that standard brings in fresh air quickly enough to undo whatever the leaves take up
otherwise the light falling into one of them could have been blamed for anything the plants appeared to do
the air in the rooms would otherwise have been swapped so often that any change the plants made would have been buried
the dampest room in the trial was still drier than the air outside the building that day
the workers marked them just as accurately, and just as fast, as they had in a bare room
it left the workers less unhappy than the bare room did without leaving them any more cheerful
the tropical arrangement did more for the workers' mood than the Japanese one did

items.prompt: The team saw no danger in the moisture the ferns released, because
items.evidence: Damp air brings its own risks, but the readings never passed 70 per cent, the level at which mould becomes a concern.
items.grammar_check: Oturan iki rakip son tek tek: (1) E — 'the dampest room in the trial was still drier than the air outside the building that day': dogru cevapla ayni isi goren bir 'nem hicbir zaman yuksege cikmadi' ifadesi, 'because' sonrasinda dilbilgisi olarak kusursuz ve anlamca en az A kadar cazip; metin dis havanin nemi hakkinda hicbir sey soylemiyor. (2) B — 'a room of that standard brings in fresh air quickly enough to undo whatever the leaves take up': surekli tazelenen bir odada nemin birikmeyecegi okumasini veriyor, tam bir yan cumle; metinde gecen bir cumledir ama orada nemin degil karbondioksitin akibetini acikliyor. Ayrica D ('the air in the rooms would otherwise have been swapped so often...') de ayni cerceveye oturuyor. Dordu de 'nem neden sorun degil' sorusuna cevap veriyor; ayrim yalniz C paragrafinin son cumlesindeki yetmis puanlik mantar esiginden yapilabiliyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph C says that although damp air carries its own risks, the readings never passed 70 per cent, the level at which mould becomes a concern; the highest figure recorded was 49.2 per cent.

items.prompt: One of the things the three rooms had in common was chosen with a particular worry in mind, because
items.evidence: The rooms were chosen because they resembled one another closely: each had a ceiling 3.0 metres high, a window area of 4.3 square metres and the same northern outlook, so that daylight could not be blamed for whatever the plants appeared to do.
items.grammar_check: Oturan iki rakip son tek tek: (1) D — 'the air in the rooms would otherwise have been swapped so often that any change the plants made would have been buried': bir karistirici degiskeni disarida birakma gerekcesi olarak koke birebir oturuyor, tam bir yan cumle ve C ile ayni 'otherwise' kalibinda. (2) B — 'a room of that standard brings in fresh air quickly enough to undo whatever the leaves take up': odalarin ortak ozelliginin neden onemsendigini aciklayan ikinci bir gerekce olarak dilbilgisi ve anlam bakimindan sorunsuz. Kok hangi ortak ozellikten soz ettigini soylemedigi icin isiga giden bir sozcuk koprusu yok; secim yalniz B paragrafinin ikinci cumlesindeki 'so that daylight could not be blamed' ifadesinden yapilabiliyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says the rooms were matched for ceiling height, window area and outlook so that daylight could not be blamed for whatever the plants appeared to do.

items.prompt: One piece of the building's equipment stayed switched off from the first reading to the last, because
items.evidence: The air conditioning was switched off throughout, because a running system shifts so much air that it would have buried any effect the plants had.
items.grammar_check: Oturan iki rakip son tek tek: (1) C — 'otherwise the light falling into one of them could have been blamed for anything the plants appeared to do': kok hangi cihazdan soz ettigini soylemedigi icin aydinlatma da okunabiliyor, dolayisiyla bu gerekce hem dilbilgisi hem anlam olarak tam oturuyor. (2) B — 'a room of that standard brings in fresh air quickly enough to undo whatever the leaves take up': bir seyi kapatmanin gerekcesi olarak makul duruyor ve metinde gercekten yazan bir cumle, ama orada klimayla degil karbondioksit sonucuyla ilgili. Kok cihazin adini vermedigi icin isik/havalandirma ikilemi ancak metinden cozuluyor: secim yalniz B paragrafinin dorduncu cumlesini okumaktan cikiyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says the air conditioning was switched off throughout, because a running system shifts so much air that it would have buried any effect the plants had.

items.prompt: After five minutes in each of the three rooms the workers sat a set of attention tests, and the results showed that
items.evidence: Performance was untouched, since accuracy and reaction times were the same in all three rooms.
items.grammar_check: Oturan iki rakip son tek tek: (1) G — 'it left the workers less unhappy than the bare room did without leaving them any more cheerful': 'the results showed that' sonrasinda dilbilgisi olarak isliyor ve ayni calismanin gercek bir bulgusu oldugu icin anlamca da tam oturuyor; yanlis olmasinin tek nedeni kokun testlerin sonucunu sormasi. (2) H — 'the tropical arrangement did more for the workers' mood than the Japanese one did': ayni cerceveden bir bulgu ifadesi, sezgisel olarak da cazip (gur bitkili oda daha iyi hissettirir beklentisi), ama metin bunun tersini soyluyor. Kok hangi olcumun sonucunu istedigini soylemiyor, bu yuzden uc bulgu da aday; ayrim yalniz I paragrafinin ucuncu ve dorduncu cumlelerini karsilastirmaktan cikiyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph I says performance was untouched, since accuracy and reaction times were the same in all three rooms.

items.prompt: Even the better of the two planted rooms fell short of what might have been hoped, because
items.evidence: The planted rooms did something to mood: the Japanese arrangement produced less negative feeling than the bare room, and less than the tropical arrangement, although neither lifted positive feeling.
items.grammar_check: Oturan iki rakip son tek tek: (1) F — 'the workers marked them just as accurately, and just as fast, as they had in a bare room': 'fell short ... because' cercevesine kusursuz oturan bir eksiklik gerekcesi ve metinde dogru bir cumle; yanlis olmasinin nedeni kokun iki bitkili odadan iyisini, yani ruh haliyle ilgili sinirlamayi sormasi. (2) H — 'the tropical arrangement did more for the workers' mood than the Japanese one did': ayni karsilastirma cercevesinde, dilbilgisi olarak sorunsuz ve sezgisel olarak inandirici; metin bunun tersini soyluyor. Cozucu bu yuzden 'hangi eksiklik' sorusunu ancak I paragrafinin ucuncu cumlesindeki 'although neither lifted positive feeling' kaydiyla yanitlayabiliyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph I says the Japanese arrangement produced less negative feeling than the bare room and less than the tropical arrangement, although neither arrangement lifted positive feeling.

groups.instructions:
Questions 6-10 refer to Passage G07 - What Houseplants Really Do to the Air Indoors

Complete each sentence with the correct ending, A-H.
Write the correct letter, A-H, in boxes 6-10 on your answer sheet.

options.text: it took out 33.12 per cent of the coarsest material sent through the box
it led the field on the finest particles, removing 39.86 per cent of them
the rougher leaf was holding 5.286 micrograms of sulphate on every square centimetre, against 1.714 on the smoother one
it gathered between one and a half and two times as much as the smoothest-leaved of the five
at eight in the morning the box holding a plant read higher than the box holding none
a bushy plant slows the air moving through a small space, so that particles linger instead of passing through
what a leaf catches in a sealed box is a poor guide to a home with people living in it
the leaves were giving back some of the dust they had taken up earlier in the day

items.prompt: In the runs with a prepared mist, the Chinese honey locust stood out in one respect:
items.evidence: The Chinese honey locust, with thicker and waxier leaves, did its best work on the largest particles, removing 33.12 per cent of the coarse fraction.
items.grammar_check: Oturan iki rakip son tek tek: (1) B — 'it led the field on the finest particles, removing 39.86 per cent of them': ayni cerceveden (bir turun one ciktigi olcum) tam bir cumle, iki noktadan sonra dilbilgisi olarak sorunsuz; metinde baska bir ture ait. (2) D — 'it gathered between one and a half and two times as much as the smoothest-leaved of the five': yine 'bir turun ustunlugu' ifadesi, koke birebir oturuyor; metinde bu deger pagoda agacinin. Kok tur adini veriyor ama hangi olcumde one ciktigini soylemiyor, ve sonlarin hicbiri tur adi tasimiyor; dolayisiyla eslestirme yalniz F paragrafindaki sayilardan yapilabiliyor. Cift dogru kontrolu: E kokun disinda birakildi (E disari havasiyla yapilan kosuya ait, kok ise hazirlanmis sisli kosuyu adlandiriyor), boylece bal keciboynuzuna ait ikinci bir dogru son olusmuyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph F says the Chinese honey locust did its best work on the largest particles, removing 33.12 per cent of the coarse fraction.

items.prompt: The purple-leaf peach carries grooves on its leaves but hardly any hairs, and yet
items.evidence: The purple-leaf peach has grooves but few hairs, yet it led on the smallest particles, taking out 39.86 per cent.
items.grammar_check: Oturan iki rakip son tek tek: (1) A — 'it took out 33.12 per cent of the coarsest material sent through the box': 'and yet' baglacindan sonra beklenmedik bir basari ifadesi olarak dilbilgisi ve anlam bakimindan kusursuz; metinde bal keciboynuzuna ait. (2) D — 'it gathered between one and a half and two times as much as the smoothest-leaved of the five': ayni sasirtici-ustunluk cercevesine oturuyor; metinde pagoda agacina ait. C de bicimsel olarak isliyor. Hicbir son tur adi tasimadigi ve sayilar disaridan bilinemeyecegi icin secim yalniz F paragrafinin son cumlesinden yapilabiliyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph F says the purple-leaf peach has grooves but few hairs, yet it led on the smallest particles, taking out 39.86 per cent.

items.prompt: The leaves were rinsed and shaken before the two extremes were weighed against each other, and it emerged that
items.evidence: A pagoda tree leaf was carrying 5.286 micrograms of sulphate for every square centimetre; the same area of kerria leaf held 1.714 micrograms.
items.grammar_check: Oturan iki rakip son tek tek: (1) D — 'it gathered between one and a half and two times as much as the smoothest-leaved of the five': kokun 'iki uc' karsilastirmasina tam oturan bir oran ifadesi, dilbilgisi olarak sorunsuz; ama bu oran yikama isleminden degil, F paragrafindaki birikim hizi olcumunden geliyor. (2) A — 'it took out 33.12 per cent of the coarsest material sent through the box': 'it emerged that' sonrasinda isleyen, ayni deneyden gelen bir baska sayi; hangi sayinin yikanan yapraklardan cikan sayi oldugu ancak G paragrafi okunarak bilinebiliyor. B de bicimsel olarak isliyor. Uc sayi da metnin kendi olctugu degerler oldugu icin disaridan tahmin edilemiyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph G says that after the leaves had been rinsed in deionised water and shaken, a pagoda tree leaf was carrying 5.286 micrograms of sulphate per square centimetre against 1.714 micrograms on the same area of kerria leaf.

items.prompt: When ordinary outdoor air was used, the boxes with plants in them sometimes read higher than the box without, and the team put this down to the fact that
items.evidence: The likely reason is not that the leaves gave dust back, but that a bushy plant slows the air moving through a small space, so particles linger instead of passing through.
items.grammar_check: Oturan iki rakip son tek tek: (1) H — 'the leaves were giving back some of the dust they had taken up earlier in the day': 'put this down to the fact that' cercevesine kusursuz oturuyor ve sezgisel olarak en cazip aciklama; metin bu aciklamayi acikca reddediyor ('not that the leaves gave dust back'). (2) G — 'what a leaf catches in a sealed box is a poor guide to a home with people living in it': ayni sekilde tam bir yan cumle ve makul bir gerekce; metinde ise bu, son paragraftaki genel sonuc, bu kosunun aciklamasi degil. Cozucu ancak H paragrafinin son cumlesini okuyarak reddedilen aciklamayi kabul edilenden ayirabiliyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph H says the likely reason is not that the leaves gave dust back, but that a bushy plant slows the air moving through a small space, so particles linger instead of passing through.

items.prompt: The word filtering is the wrong one for what a shelf of pots does at home, because
items.evidence: Filtering, though, is the wrong word for what a shelf of pots does, because what a leaf catches in a sealed chamber is a poor guide to an occupied home, where opening a window still shifts more of everything than the plants ever will.
items.grammar_check: Oturan iki rakip son tek tek: (1) F — 'a bushy plant slows the air moving through a small space, so that particles linger instead of passing through': 'because' sonrasinda dilbilgisi olarak sorunsuz ve suzgec benzetmesini curuten cok makul bir gerekce; metinde ise H paragrafindaki tek bir kosunun aciklamasi. (2) E — 'at eight in the morning the box holding a plant read higher than the box holding none': ayni sekilde tam bir yan cumle ve 'suzmuyor' iddiasini destekleyen bir gozlem; metin bunu son paragrafin gerekcesi olarak kullanmiyor. H de bicimsel ve anlamsal olarak isliyor. Ayrim yalniz J paragrafinin son cumlesindeki gerekceden yapilabiliyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph J says filtering is the wrong word because what a leaf catches in a sealed chamber is a poor guide to an occupied home, where opening a window still shifts more of everything than the plants ever will.
